documents.title: University of Maryland, Baltimore Artificial Intelligence (AI) Guidelines
documents.summary: University-wide guidelines from the Provost, CITS, University Counsel and CHHS, organized by audience (instructors, students, researchers, administrators). They set no student-use rule and leave classroom permission to each instructor, while setting firm rules on data protection, approved tools, AI detectors and disclosure. Most of the content concerns privacy (HIPAA, FERPA), research and administrative use.
documents.stance_why: The guidelines say "UMB does not dictate that faculty and instructors shall require or prohibit the use of generative AI" and "It will be at the course instructor's discretion", with a syllabus statement expected. No default for student use is set, so delegates. (Both coders agreed.)
